prompts.studio: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached existing Aether STUDIO application icon. Deliver ONE standalone transparent PNG of its existing capital A symbol, with REAL alpha transparency, at 1024 by 1024. Carefully isolate the A from its square navy icon background. Preserve the exact distinctive asymmetric silhouette, diagonal rising crossbar, triangular interior hole, broad feet, proportions, blue/cyan faceted colors and existing surface details of the supplied A. Do not redesign, add text, alter the A construction, add objects or crop its tips. Center the complete A with about 10 percent transparent margin on every side. This is an asset extraction, preserving the existing identity, not a new logo concept.
